messages:
zoe_marketing: Hey runtime team — quick ask for the webinar on Tue. We have a draft claim: "3x latency vs competitor at 1/2 the cost". Need a lightweight repro/smoke run to validate numbers (quantized + fp16), and a short runbook we can link in the deck.

matt_runtime: Can do. Scope: which model + payloads? and do you need warmup profile traces or just single-shot numbers?

zoe_marketing: Primary model = redwood-infer/xl-1b (quantized q4_0 + fp16). Two payload sizes: short (prompt ~40 tokens) and long (prompt ~2k tokens context). Target metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost per token. Also need coldstart vs steady-state comparison for the short prompt. Warmup traces would be great but we can accept just a perf artifact + sample payloads.

matt_runtime: Got it. Do you have exact sample prompts or should we synthesize a representative cohort? Also, what SLA window for the run?

zoe_marketing: We'll attach a tiny sample set here in the thread. Ideally within 48h so we can prep slides. For the cohort, please use the short list (5 samples) + a single long sample — representative of chat history and long-recall doc.

zoe_marketing: sample payloads:
```
{
  "prompt_short": "Summarize the latest release notes in 2 bullets.",
  "prompt_long": "<very long doc ~2k tokens>.. followup: extract dates and actions"
}
```

sanjay_runtime: FYI GPU queue for dedicated nodes is heavy today, I can run this on a spot-like pool but quantized fp runs are fast. If you need strict coldstart SLA we might have to reserve a node. Which matters more: absolute cold latency or typical steady-state?

ellie_product: From messaging POV we need conservative phrasing. If the warmup delta is >15% we can't claim a direct competitor comparison without qualifiers. Please include standard deviation and sample size in outputs.

matt_runtime: Understood. Plan: 1) quick smoke on quantized + fp16 (short & long) to collect p50/p95 + tokens/sec, 2) coldstart probe (3 cold restarts) for short prompt, 3) package results + minimal runbook with commands and exact env. ETA 36h if run queued, 18h if we reserve.

zoe_marketing: 36h ok. Please include the exact command we can paste in the appendix.

matt_runtime: Will do. Example command we'll run (and include in runbook):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-infer/xl-1b","input":"Summarize the latest release notes in 2 bullets.","max_tokens":128,"warmup":false}'
```

ci-bot: perf-job queued: job_id=perf-1712348800-01, estimated_start=1712349000

sanjay_runtime: Queued job noted. If anything fails I'll ping on #eng-runtime.

zoe_marketing: Thanks everyone — will wait for artifacts. Please upload traces + a 1-slide summary with the numbers we can use in the deck. :pray:
